title: Exact versus closed discrete entropy-form first-principles controls
proposition: Explore the mathematical constraints on entropy 1-forms by contrasting exact gradients with closed non-exact 1-cochains in a finite cycle complex.
falsifier: A purported nonzero circulation for a globally single-valued exact discrete gradient contradicts the telescoping identity and indicates an implementation or assumption error.

sources: Hand-defined four-edge graph and single filled-square cell complex; elementary discrete cochain algebra.
No imported ECC/RTCH empirical data and no upstream topology evidence.

limitations: Finite synthetic cell complexes do not establish persistent cohomology for observed spacetime or galaxies.
Closedness on an unfilled graph must not be mistaken for closedness of the same cochain on a filled square.
No thermodynamic or gravitational entropy coupling is inferred.
